children: Barrel Energy executed an LOI to acquire a 51% controlling interest in Maine Standard Biofuels for aggregate consideration of $20,000,000.
LOI contemplates $20,000,000 aggregate purchase price for a 51% interest, payable in cash and shares of an exchange-listed issuer.
Initial cash equals 50% of committed principal of a qualifying credit facility tied to a separate national-exchange transaction.
Closing conditioned on completion of the exchange transaction, establishment/funding of the credit facility, diligence, approvals and lawful share issuance.
LOI is non-binding except for confidentiality, announcements and limited expense provisions; definitive agreement required to obligate parties.
